title: A generic locally finitely presented open piece for arbitrary condensed coefficients
statement: Let T be a scheme with noetherian underlying space, Λ a commutative condensed ring object, and M a constructible module over its pro-etale coefficient ring on T. Either M is locally finitely presented on all of T, or there is a nonempty open U of T such that the coefficient-compatible pullback of M to U is locally finitely presented. This statement includes the empty scheme and imposes no field hypothesis on Λ.

proof.text: If T is nonempty, choose the finite locally closed stratification in constructibility. The union of the interiors of its strata is dense, so choose a nonempty interior U of one stratum. Apply immersion presentation transport to the inclusion of U and that stratum.

Use the canonical coefficient pullback isomorphism to transport the raw module presentations to condensedUpperStar. If T is empty, sections on each pro-etale object are zero; faithfulness of forgetting modules makes M zero. Zero modules have rank-zero finite presentations.
